notes.title: Version 3.30 : Hot off the Iron!
notes.content:
[h1]IT'S FINALLY HERE![/h1][p]Thank you everyone for waiting so patiently. As promised, the big update has finally been posted! Without any ado, let's jump right into what's new![/p][p][/p][h2]Main Features[/h2][list][*][p]Hot new menu design, including refreshed sprites, better organization, and lots of new settings![/p][/*][*][p]The forging minigame has been completely overhauled. New tools, a fancy new layout, and all new sprites![/p][/*][*][p]Order scroll requests have new alloy and craft requirement variants. The more specific the request, the more extra coin you'll earn![/p][/*][*][p][b]Experimental localization is now implemented!!![/b] You can now play the game in English, Deutsch, Español, Français, Italiano, Polski, Português Brasileiro, Русский, 简体中文, or 日本語 
[i](please note that some translations are still missing, the localization is actively being worked on)[/i][/p][/*][/list][h3]A huge shoutout to everyone who has contributed to the localization effort![/h3][p]As stated above, [u]there are going to be some missing translations still[/u]. The localization project is a big [b]big[/b] undertaking, and it's going to take a lot more work until it's perfect, but we're off to a [b][i]great start[/i][/b]! Please be patient while I work on finishing the implementation and while my trusty translators work on the new content that still needs translating. [b]Polska Gurom![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43930998/d78b7cc51ae21b67270db42cc212bda763c14d91.png"][/img][/p][p]But wait, [i]that isn't all!~[/i] Get ready to be spoiled, here's everything else that's been added to the game since the last big update![/p][p][/p][h2]New Content[/h2][list][*][p][b]new pegs added to the shop, can be used to store tools in the background layer[/b][/p][/*][*][p]discovering a new alloy will now display a banner & play a fun little tune[/p][/*][*][p][b]you can now pin alloy recipes from the journal[/b][/p][/*][*][p]discovering alloys will now reveal a fun fact about them in the journal[/p][/*][*][p][b]window resizing is now properly supported (no more black bars on the sides)[/b][/p][/*][*][p]new save name suffixes (previously only "Smithery" could be used)[/p][/*][*][p]new gameplay setting to prevent the crucible from tipping over (unless using the tipper)[/p][/*][*][p]new 'dim-assist' setting darkens the background to help increase visibility of items[/p][/*][*][p]added setting that will sync the color of ores and their ingot counterparts[/p][/*][*][p]new setting can disable the automatic camera slowdown that occurs when holding "heavy" objects[/p][/*][*][p]new setting to control the speed of edge-panning[/p][/*][*][p]new settings to disable backgrounds and/or fancy liquids (can help improve performance)[/p][/*][*][p]several new chatling commands[/p][/*][*][p]the bucket now has a customizable label[/p][/*][*][p]cages and balls can now be purchased from the shop for chatlings[/p][/*][*][p]a new art piece has been added to the shop[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43930998/ec1fdc2764e9c3e45b75e86e189aa093e500657b.png"][/img][/p][h2]Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]adjusted values of all metals to reduce vast price variances[/b][/p][/*][*][p]improved player character's penmanship (new font to support localization)[/p][/*][*][p]gameplay settings are now saved per-save file rather than globally across all save files[/p][/*][*][p]adjusted stone spawn rate and size frequency[/p][/*][*][p]metal now emits light when it is very hot[/p][/*][*][p]metal now glows different colors depending on how hot it is[/p][/*][*][p]added over 40 chatling appearance variants[/p][/*][*][p]a small fist is now displayed when chatlings grab something[/p][/*][*][p]updated various sprites and sounds[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43930998/aadfc9f4d25493a660cf8a6bb80f386fa65f3036.png"][/img][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p][b]implemented many many changes to help reduce lag on different systems[/b][/p][/*][*][p]you can no longer make "super-ingots" by placing the mold inside the crucible[/p][/*][*][p]improved functionality of cranks (they should stutter less often while being used)[/p][/*][*][p]lazy-bones should be much less finicky (no more zooming when you meant to crank)[/p][/*][*][p]fixed various chatling related crashes[/p][/*][*][p]added limits to certain chatling commands[/p][/*][*][p]updated chatling goops to no longer be burning hot[/p][/*][*][p]implemented new catch for potential save file errors[/p][/*][*][p]fixed various descriptions & spellings[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Plus a whole bunch of little things here and there that I've already forgotten about.[/p][p][/p][h2]Known Bugs[/h2][p]Some bugs didn't get squashed, so you'll probably encounter these:[/p][list][*][p]Resizing the window while in the main menu stretches the game (resize it again once you've loaded into your save to fix this.)[/p][/*][*][p]Audio only plays from the left side in the main menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Plenty of text in the game is not translated properly yet, but most of the important stuff is.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Performance Issues[/h2][p]Despite my best efforts, I still get reports of some players experiencing terrible lag while playing, despite being able to run other games fine. Please be assured I am constantly looking into this and trying different things to resolve the issue, but I haven't seemed to fix it for everyone just yet. This update contains a LOT of changes that should help improve performance, but if not, please let me know so I can keep tackling the issue.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43930998/334f9dbb482f56ecc1c8d90855306048141c0a90.png"][/img][/p][h2]New Banner[/h2][p]You may have noticed, the game has a new Library banner! Huge thank you to Blaffski for making it, it came out absolutely amazing. Check them out on their [url="https://twitter.com/Blaffeeyvhs"]Twitter[/url] or [url="https://www.twitch.tv/blaffski"]Twitch[/url] if you have the chance, they're an amazing artist and you should buy art from them.[/p][p][/p][h2]What's Next?[/h2][p]That's all for now! Thank you again for waiting while I cooked up this update. I'm the only developer on this project, so sometimes things take a while and life gets in the way of progress, but rest assured I still have a lot of plans for Alnico Smithery. I don't know when the next update will be ready, but it's gonna be pretty dang neat if everything goes according to plan. No spoilers though! You'll just have to wait and see what I have in store.[/p][p]If you haven't yet, I strongly encourage you to join the community Discord if you want to keep up to date on the state of the game and my other projects! It's also a great place to ask questions, troubleshoot, and make friends who all like the silly smithing game.[/p][p][b]
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43930998/555169dc94cd4deff4404f084dd89b643557bd9d.png"][/img][/p][p]Until next time, I hope you enjoy the new content. Adiós! [/p][p][b]-Pinapl[/b][/p]

notes.title: State of the Game (7/14/2025)
notes.content:
[h3]Hello friends and strangers, [/h3][p]your favorite fruit cube is here with a much needed update on the state of the game. [/p][p][/p][h2]Where have I been?[/h2][p]I'm glad you asked![/p][p]I want to start by apologizing for the lack of presence I've had on Steam. While work has continued since the last update, I've neglected to keep you all in the know. [/p][p]If you have and use Discord, [u]I strongly encourage you to join the community server[/u], linked on the game's Store page. I post frequent updates on the game's development there, including a changelog, regular progress reports, and announcements for [b]big news[/b]. It's also a great way to keep in touch with you all and how you feel about the game.[/p][p]So to answer the question, where have I been? Nowhere, really. In the past half a year, I've done a little travelling, I had some important medical work done, and have been occasionally burnt out from work, but most of all, I have been working on the game. Sometimes progress is slow, but don't worry: I have not abandoned this project. [/p][p]Moving on to more exciting news...[/p][h2]What's coming in the next update?[/h2][p]I'll be writing up a full changelog once the update comes out, but since I'm sure you're curious what has taken so long to finish, let's go over some of the upcoming changes! Disregarding features mentioned in previous experimental build posts, you can look forward to...[/p][list][*][p]Gems, although their purpose is still a secret...[/p][/*][*][p]New forging minigames, and refreshed old minigames,[/p][/*][*][p]New order scroll request types,[/p][/*][*][p]Completely re-vamped menus,[/p][/*][*][p]New and improved Smith Journal,[/p][/*][*][p]Experimental localization support! (10 languages currently partially supported),[/p][/*][*][p]Window resizing support! No more black bars on the sides,[/p][/*][*][p]Lots and lots of tweaks to help improve performance, improve existing features, etc...[/p][/*][*][p]And more! You'll just have to wait and see... So,[/p][/*][/list][h2]When is the next update?[/h2][p]Soon! [/p][p]Progress has been good, and I truly expect the next big update to be ready for release before the end of the month. New experimental builds have been getting pushed out in secret, and bugs have been getting squashed left and right. I appreciate everyone's patience while I work on it. I am the only artist & programmer working on this game, so unfortunately things can move slowly at times, but progress is always being made! [/p][p]With that being said, I will be returning to the code hole to continue working on the update. Next time you hear from me, it should be the big update announcement! Thanks again for all of your support, I hope you continue to enjoy my game <3[/p][p][/p][p]-Pinapl

PS. Want your name to appear in-game? Now's your chance! Submit your name through this google form and your name could appear on order scrolls and more! [url="https://forms.gle/NXbmPNu5ugCv8Vx97"]https://forms.gle/NXbmPNu5ugCv8Vx97[/url][/p]

notes.title: Localization Underway!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone, Pinapl here![/h3]
At long last, I have compiled a big ol' list of strings from the game and uploaded them to a free online resource that will let everyone help contribute to the localization of the game!

Currently, we are translating the game into the following languages:
[list]
[*] Afrikaans
[*] Chinese
[*] Czech
[*] Danish
[*] "Australian"
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Italian
[*] Japanese
[*] Polish
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] Russian
[*] Spanish
[/list]
[b]If you speak one of these languages natively and want to help contribute, you can make a free account and help translate the game [url=https://crowdin.com/project/alnico-smithery]HERE[/url]!
[/b]
The localization effort is ongoing and there will be more strings to translate, but several volunteers have already gotten a lot of work done. [b]Thank you all who've been working on this[/b], I appreciate you greatly.

There is not currently a way to change your language in-game, but once more of the translations are finished and more back-end work is complete, there will be a big update announcement letting you all know that it's ready to use!

That's all for now, see you in the next update!
-Pinapl

notes.title: Early Access 3.15 Experimental Build
notes.content:
Happy holidays, everyone! I'm trying to push out a fun little holiday update this month, so please enjoy this experimental update with oodles of little changes. Let me know if anything is glaringly broken asap please so we can push this to the public build!

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Completely re-done settings menu
[*] Added a few new settings, listed below
[*] Festive holiday decorations have been hung up in the smithery
[*] Chatlings now spawn wearing a festive costume for the season
[/list]
[h3]Settings[/h3]
[list]
[*] Setting to disable the automatic camera slowdown you experience while holding heavy objects
[*] Setting to lock crucible rotation

notes.title: Early Access 3.14 Hotfix
notes.content:
I got a report that someone's saves were wiped after updating and we can't have that.

I can't fix what's gone, but going forward I have implemented a secondary error catcher that should grab your save file and push it into a different file if something goes wrong so I can diagnose and fix it afterwards.

notes.title: Early Access 3.10 Released!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, smiths! Pinapl here with the first real update since Early Access released![/h3]

First of all, I want to thank everyone for your patience while I recovered from covid, and for all the wonderful feedback I've received. I've been doing my best to read all the discussions, reports, and reviews, and it's been incredible to see how many people are enjoying the game. Thank you so much everyone!!! <3 <3 <3

With this update, a majority of the focus was on fixing or improving the existing content based on the feedback I've been getting. There's still plenty of little bugs to fix and changes to make, but this update will cover some of the most pressing complaints I've seen. Without further ado, let's go over what's new!

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now re-summon the Merchant any time by paying the Crow!
[*] New tools, including a Bucket, Extra Crucibles, and a Big Crucible are purchasable from the Merchant.
[*] New crafting minigame sprites for 28/40 Crafts!
[*] New crafting minigame target layouts for all 40 crafts + rebalanced difficulty levels.
[*] New Twitch commands for chatters, including !float, !chase, !grab, and !help.
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now press "TAB" to open the Smithery Journal.
[*] Tongs now center on the mouse cursor.
[*] Tongs now grab ingots before the molds they are placed in.
[*] Metal will now never melt while being held by the Tongs.
[*] Magnet strength has been increased slightly.
[*] Coins will now spawn above your Piggy if you have one.
[*] Bug Jars are now less prone to spinning wildly.
[*] Order Scrolls will now spawn further to the left.
[*] Scales now display carbon content.
[*] Halloween rope and cobwebs have been removed for the season :(
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Transmutation has been fixed.
[*] Buying/Selling stats are now tracked properly.
[*] Tier 3 Refinery once again properly displays how much unprocessed stone is inside it.
[*] Terrarium residents are more consistent with their un-captured counterparts.
[*] The Piggy King achievement is now achieveable with the placeholder craft.
[*] Extra refinery switches should no longer spawn when upgrading.
[*] Burnt Potatoes can no longer turn into Perfectly Cooked Potatoes.
[*] Certain Items are now properly saved between games.
[*] Molten metal should be less prone to eratic temperature differences while inside the crucible.
[*] Pinned scrolls no longer open if an object is released in front of them.
[*] Fixed a rare crash caused by the Merchant trying to give you an order for an alloy that doesn't exist.
[*] Chatlings can now burn if exposed to molten metal outside the furnace.
[*] Chatlings can no longer crash the game by screaming.
[/list]

Plus plenty of minor fixes and changes not worth noting here. I hope everyone has fun with the new items and content, I'll keep working hard at adding new content and polishing existing stuff. Thank you everyone who has been reporting bugs and suggestions, I read them all and it helps me a ton when working on the game. Keep it up, and I'll see you all in the next update!

-Pinapl

PS. There is currently a name suggestion thread in the discord for what to name the Crow, so consider joining so you can help decide what its name will be!

PPS. Localization is coming! I am currently working on organizing all the text that needs translating, and when it's ready there will be a public spreadsheet for anyone to join and help the translation effort. I will post an update when it's ready!

notes.title: Early Access 3.05 Experimental Build
notes.content:
The update is almost ready for the public branch, but first I want to make sure that I didn't muck anything up in the past few days. I've added new crafting recipe data for all 40 crafts, and finished crafting sprites for 28 of them! If everyone could please craft a bunch of stuff and make sure nothing breaks, that would be great. I'll go over exactly what's been updated below now!

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Each craft has a revised mingame recipe. Aka: the hammer targets positions and how many appear have been reworked. Each craft will have a new 'array' of hammer targets.
[*] Along with the new minigame arrays, each craft has had its difficulty reworked. Some are easier, some are harder. Trophies are still the hardest craft to make.
[*] 28 Crafts now have crafting sprites! 12 Will now default to a "craft" crafting sprite. The crafting sprite is the graphic you see while you are crafting an item on the anvil.
[*] No crafts have updated models or textures at this time, many will still appear as "CRAFT"s.
[/list]

Hopefully that all makes sense! To recap: the crafting minigame has new hammer target arrangements and new sprites. Hopefully nothing breaks and this update will get pushed to the public build before the weekend! Please report any bugs to the Discord. Thanks!!!

-Pinapl

notes.title: Early Access 3.02 Experimental Build
notes.content:
It's me again! I've peered into your hearts and determined what you truly desire: another experimental build! Same deal as the last one, you'll have to opt-in to the experimental branch in steam betas. Theoretically, this build will be more stable than the last. Focused on bug fixes this time around.

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Pressing "TAB" now opens the smithery journal if you have one.
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cobwebs and Halloween rope have been removed for the season.
[*] Order scrolls now spawn further to the left.
[*] Bucket will now melt if you heat it up too much (bucket, not crucible)
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Big Crucible has had it's back-sprite returned.
[*] Buying and Selling stats are now properly tracked.
[*] Hat spiders in terrariums should no longer have floating hats.
[*] Pinned scrolls no longer open if you let go of an object while hovering the scroll.
[*] Scales now properly show carbon in their calculations.
[*] Merchant no longer gives you more scrolls if you haven't finished your other ones yet.
[*] You can no longer burn yourself on the big crucible.
[*] Theoretically fixed a rare crash when given scrolls by the merchant.
[/list]

I've finally fixed the stat tracking for Money Earned, Items Sold, Orders Fufilled, and Items Purchased. There's some code in the game that will award you its best estimation of how much money you've earned and items you've purchased up until this point, but unfortunetely I had no way to estimate how many items and orders have been sold/fufilled. It should be tracked properly going forward, sorry for the error <3

As always, thank you everyone who's giving feedback and bug reports, it's very very appreciated and helps me fix what needs fixing. Until next time, bye bye!

notes.title: Early Access 3.01 Experimental Build
notes.content:
Hello smiths, it's me!!! I've finally recovered after getting covid a few weeks ago, and to celebrate, here's a new build for you! In order to play on the experimental build, you will have to opt-in to the experimental build in the Steam Betas tab. Google is your friend if you aren't sure how to do this.

It's been amazing seeing how many people have bought and played the game already, I wanna thank everyone again for all the support. Please consider leaving a steam review if you can, every review helps out a TON! And thank you everyone who's joined the discord and provided valuable feedback and bug reports. You're all the best!

Now without further ado, let's get into what's new in this version! 

[h3]Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now re-summon the merchant for 5c with the help of a new friend.
[*] Added a bucket to the merchant's wares. 
[*] Added a bigger crucible to the merchant's wares.
[*] Chatlings can now use !float, !chase, !grab, and !help commands.
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tongs now properly grab ingots out of molds instead of grabbing the molds themselves.
[*] Tongs are now centered on the cursor.
[*] Ingots will no longer melt while held with tongs.
[*] Magnet strength increased slightly.
[*] Coins will now spawn above your piggy bank if you have one.
[*] Craft "messy" sprite benchmark increased from 60% to 75% quality.
[*] Crucibles have been re-added to the merchant's wares.
[*] Adjusted error-catching code for an elusive load-save bug.
[*] Molten metal should now properly share temperatures when inside the crucible.
[*] Chatlings can now burn even if outside the furnace.
[*] Reduced the jar's tendency to spin wildly.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tier 3 Refinery now properly displays how much unprocessed rock it contains.
[*] Terrarium spiders should look much more like they are supposed to now (but they still won't animate).
[*] The Piggy King achievement should now be achieveable with the temporary crown sprite.
[*] Extra switches should no longer spawn on the refinery when upgrading it.
[*] Rocks no longer stay hot forever.
[*] Burnt Potatoes can no longer turn into Perfectly Cooked Potatoes.
[*] Potato cook state is now properly saved.
[*] Artwork now persists between loads.
[*] Chatlings should no longer crash the game when screaming.
[*] Fixed transmutation code, it should be less janky now.
[/list]

Please keep in mind: this is an experimental build. Things are likely to go wrong or work incorrectly. Please report any issues you find in the discord server and if everything goes well, a stable update will be pushed out sometime this week! Thanks everyone!!!

notes.title: Early Access Begins!
notes.content:
[h1]It's Smitherying Time![/h1]
[h3]It's finally here, Alnico Smithery is publically available to buy and play![/h3]
Hello all, it's your favorite fruit cube back again. For those who don't know, my name is Pinapl, and i'm the sole developer for Alnico Smithery. After 20~ months of development in my free time, Alnico Smithery is here. What a rush! Granted, this is really only the starting line. 

[h3]Early Access?[/h3]
The game is still in active development, and there is even more content to come, and existing content is subject to change. I want to be very clear that while the game is in a fairly stable state, there is always the chance that you will encounter bugs, and things may break. Please report any issues you discover so I cna work to fix them up and get this game running as smoothly as possible! 

[h3]Future Content?[/h3]
You can read more about the current plans for the game in my previous post "What's Next", but to summarize: more stuff! I have plenty of plans, and plenty more popping into my head on a daily basis. I don't have any timeframe for the new content, but it'll come when it's ready.

[h3]That's All, Folks.[/h3]
Honestly, I don't have much else to say! I'm so pumped for everyone to be able to try out the full version, so I won't take up any more time and let you get to it! The game will be discounted for the first week of early access, so get it cheap while you can!!! Thanks everyone for all your support, I hope you'll have fun playing my game! <3

-Pinapl

notes.title: What's Next?
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone, it's your favorite citrus back with an update.[/h2]
With Next Fest drawing to a close, I wanted to take this moment to both thank everyone who's tried out the game and let you know what you can look forward to with the full release, coming to early access [b]October 25th[/b]! (That's in less than 5 days!)

[h2]First of all, THANK YOU![/h2]
Next Fest has been [b]huge[/b] for visibility. Over the past week it's been incredible to see how many folks have checked out the game, tried the demo, left comments, etc. I've gotten a lot of great feedback and it's been a blast hanging out with some of the streamers who tried out the game live. With all seriousness, from the bottom of my heart, [b]thank you everyone[/b]! With the sappy stuff out of the way, lets talk about:

[h2]What to expect from the FULL VERSION![/h2]
Many of you have been playing the crap out of the demo, even figuring out stuff I hadn't thought of (like using your money to get silver and gold early!) So, what should you expect from buying the full game?
[h3]More Metals[/h3]
The full game will give you access to all 16 base elements, and all 100 possible alloys! In the demo, you only have access to tier 1 alloys (tier 2 if you figured out the coins). Now, you'll have access to all 5 tiers! But that's not all...
[h3]More Tools[/h3]
The merchant will finally start selling you more stuff, including new tools to use in the workshop! I think you'll find some of these [i]very [/i]useful. You'll also find new ingot mold types, which will let you unlock all 40 crafting recipes in the game! Among the merchant's wares, you'll also find:
[h3]Refinery & Furnace Upgrades[/h3]
Leveling your Refinery will unlock new ores, more storage space, and faster refining, while leveling your Furnace will let you get it [i]much [/i]hotter [i]much [/i]faster, a much needed upgrade if you want to take advantage of the new ore.
[h3]And More![/h3]
It goes without saying, but as new content is added to the game, you'll gain access to all of it free of charge. There's still some really neat features I've yet to add, so let's talk about them!

[h2]What's to Come?[/h2]
The game, as is, already has plenty to try, and I won't make any promises, but here's a preview of content I plan to add over the course of development!
[h3]More Ways to Play[/h3]
Localization and controller support! Apologies to anyone who's first language isn't English, my lovely translator volunteers are working hard so hopefully some time soon you'll be able to play the game in your native language! I'll also be working on getting controller play supported, as well as more accessability options.
[h3]More Structures/Stations[/h3]
I'm working on adding/re-adding more structures to the workshop! It may seem a bit empty now, but that's so there's room for all your new stuff in the future! A basin for quenching metal, scales, a grindstone, a polishing drum, and yes, a garbage can! Plus some other stuff, like perhaps a better way to transport items or mine stone without having to do it yourself?
[h3]More Villagers![/h3]
It gets lonely with only the merchant coming to visit! Right now I have 10 total unique npcs planned, who will offer you challenges, information, and new items! I hope you look forward to meeting them all.
[h3]And, you guessed it, MORE![/h3]
I don't want to reveal all my cards yet, but know that I've got even more stuff planned for the future, like late-game mechanics and new ways to play. Not to mention, I'm sure over the course of development plenty of new ideas will come from all of you, so let me know if you think of anything else you want to see added and it might just happen!

[h2]That's about enough out of me.[/h2]
That about sums it up. [b]Thank you again everyone[/b] for checking out my game. I'm the only dev working on it, and all the support I've gotten has meant a lot. I'll keep doing my best to make a great game, and I hope you all look forward to the early access release [b]October 25th[/b]!!! (That's this upcoming Friday!!!)

That's all for now. Bye bye <3

PS. If you haven't already, consider joining the community Discord! It's the best place to reach me and learn more about the game.

notes.title: Alnico Smithery Demo Released!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone, and welcome to the announcement post.[/h2]
As the title reads, [b]the free demo is finally live![/b] Anyone can go and try out the game [b]for FREE![/b] I've been working my butt off the last few weeks to get this out, so i'm both very relieved and nervous that it's finally public! 

[previewyoutube=CM3v5ohlLv4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]For those of you who don't know me,[/h2]
My name is Pinapl, and i'm the sole developer of this game! I've been working on it as a hobby for the past year and a half, and i'm pretty excited to finally get it in the hands of some players. I'm a self-taught developer and artist, so it's been a bit of a rocky climb, but the game is coming out splendidly if I do say so myself. 

Anyways, enough about me...
[h2]What's in the Demo?[/h2]
With the demo version, you'll be able to get a good taste of what Alnico has to offer. The game starts with the beginner tutorial by default and will guide you through the various mechanics and how to play. 
With the demo, of course some features have been locked away.
[list]
[*] [b]Limited shop inventory.[/b] You'll only be able to buy 5 of the essential smithery tools in the demo.
[*] [b]No Refinery or Furnace upgrades[/b], which means only 4 ore types and a limited number of discoverable crafting recipes, as well as the slowest and least efficient versions of these stations.
[*] [b]No cheats menu[/b], which is the biggest bummer of them all. No 0 grav smithing? LAME!
[/list]
However, there is 1 plus side, which is if you purchase the full version, [b]your save data WILL carry over![/b] No progress lost, you'll be able to pick up right where you left off in the demo.

[h2]With that in mind, please look forward to the full version when it becomes available October 25th![/h2]
I'll be working hard getting things ready, I hope you all look forward to the full release!

PS. Please keep in mind this is an early access release, so you may encounter bugs or other issues. If you do, please feel free to let me know either in the [url=https://discord.gg/SeMwAFrJqm]community discord[/url] or on [url=https://pinapl.carrd.co/]social media[/url] so we can sort it out. Thanks!

notes.title: Beta Testing Resumes!
notes.content:
[h1]It's finally here, the update you've all been waiting for![/h1]
It's been quite a while since the last update, sorry about that! I've been busy making the game at least a little bit better. In this post i'll go over what's changed, where i've been, and what the future of Alnico holds!

[h2]What's new?[/h2]
Quite a lot! So much in-fact that my changelog is entirely too long for any kind of public post, but i'll give you the main points right now.
[list]
[*] Crafting has undergone a complete overhaul! The Machine TM is gone, in its place is an anvil and some tools, complete with a new crafting minigame.
[*] Crafts are rehauled too! New crafts, old crafts, and some are in the garbage. There's now 40 planned items to craft, all with unique sprites (planned) and properties.
[*] The merchant is here, and he's selling stuff! Your workshop might look a little more empty on start now, you'll have to buy those tools you took for granted from the merchant at the right of the smithery.
[*] Fossils! What do they do? They're fuel of course! Use them to power your mining equipment automatically!
[*] Upgrades are gone! In their place are special order scrolls that improve the look and ability of your ore processor and furnace. Speaking of the furnace...
[*] New textures all around! Almost everything from the furnace to the levers to the very walls have been re-textured. It all look very nice if I do say so myself.
[/list]
And a ton of other minor changes you'll have to find by yourself! There's new spiders, molten metal heats stuff up, etc etc. 

[h2]Where have I been?[/h2]
Working! Both on Alnico and on my real life job that pays my bills. It's been busy the past year, but i'm finally in a place where I can happily and healthily work on my game again. 
I never stopped working on Alnico entirely, but there certainly were long periods where I barely coded at all. I've been chipping away at it the whole time, though. Lots of the code was old, poorly written, and most of it needed rewriting. It's a lot of work making a game when you barely know how to code!
But for the forseeable future, I am back working on the game in full force! Thank you everyone for your constant support over the past many months.

[h2]So, what now? Release date?[/h2]
The number one question I keep getting asked is when Alnico is going to release to the public, and the real and truthful answer is: I don't know! 
Every time I think I have a good grasp on the timeline and make an release date estimate, it ends up taking way longer than I think! So I won't be giving any ETAs! I will say, however, that we're most certainly closer than ever before, and I'm itching to let everyone play.
Right now I am letting existing testers test some more, and I plan of giving out some more closed beta testing keys soon. The game is steadily getting finished, I thank you for your patience! 

[h2]Want to keep up with the game's development?[/h2]
While I'm not very active here on Steam, I post regular updates in the official Ganske Danske discord server, and I often stream as I add heaps of code and art to Alnico. If you wanna keep your finger on the game's pulse, I highly recommend joining the community on Discord and/or following me on Twitch! Those links are right below this text blob.
[url=https://discord.gg/B8hypkaxgh]Discord[/url]
[url=https://www.twitch.tv/pinaplll]Twitch[/url]

[h2]That's about it from me for now![/h2]
In the future you can expect to see regular updates on the game, and slowly but surely we will get closer to release, and maybe even a public beta build? We'll see. 
Until next update, bye bye!
